facts.heading: Patient is nervous about therapy
facts.content: Tomas is quite nervous about attending therapy.
facts.evidence: I am quite nervous, if I am honest.

facts.heading: Wife suggested therapy
facts.content: Tomas's wife suggested he attend therapy because things cannot continue as they are.
facts.evidence: My wife. She says it can't go on like this.

facts.heading: Compulsive checking behavior
facts.content: Tomas checks if he locked the door and turned off the stove 30 times.
facts.evidence: I check 30 times if I locked the door and turned off the stove.

facts.heading: Time taken to leave apartment
facts.content: It takes Tomas an hour before he can leave the apartment.
facts.evidence: It takes me an hour before I leave the apartment.

facts.heading: Anxiety triggers burning image
facts.content: When Tomas checks, he gets anxious and sees an image of him having to burn.
facts.evidence: I get anxious. Then an image comes to my head that I didn't do it properly and I have to burn.

facts.heading: Burning image seen daily
facts.content: Tomas sees the image of being in flames every day.
facts.evidence: Being in flames. I see it clearly like a film.

facts.heading: Worst time for anxiety
facts.content: The anxiety is worst in the evening when going out or going to sleep, and in the morning too.
facts.evidence: It's the worst in the evening when we go out or go to sleep.

facts.heading: Onset linked to house fire
facts.content: Tomas's issues started two years ago after a neighbor's house caught fire and they evacuated.
facts.evidence: It started two years ago when the neighbor's house caught fire and we had to evacuate.

facts.heading: Experience of house fire
facts.content: During the house fire, Tomas saw the neighbor's house burn from outside in the yard.
facts.evidence: I stood outside in the yard and watched the window burn.

facts.heading: Feeling of causing fire
facts.content: Since the fire, Tomas has felt that he can cause it if he doesn't control something and will be responsible.
facts.evidence: At that time, I have the feeling that I can cause it.

facts.heading: Wife knows about the issue
facts.content: Barbara, Tomas's wife, knows about his issue.
facts.evidence: Barbara. My wife.

facts.heading: Wife's perception of issue
facts.content: Barbara now sees that Tomas's issue is more than just a habit.
facts.evidence: now she sees that it's more.

facts.heading: Late arrival at cinema

facts.evidence: Yesterday we arrived at the cinema 40 minutes later.

facts.heading: Wife's reaction at cinema

facts.evidence: She waited outside for me to come back and the argument ended after the third.

facts.heading: Feeling like a child
facts.content: Tomas felt like a child who cannot leave the house.
facts.evidence: I felt like a child who can't leave the house.

facts.heading: Occupation as electrician
facts.content: Tomas works as an electrician in Malomolec. He performs wiring in apartments and houses.
facts.evidence: I work as an electrician in Malomolec. I do wiring in apartments and sometimes in houses.

facts.heading: Concerns about making mistakes
facts.content: Tomas is afraid of making mistakes, such as falling into a flood or damaging something.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid that because of my head, I might make a mistake, that I might fall into a flood or something get damaged.

facts.heading: Checks on ongoing jobs
facts.content: Tomas goes back to ongoing jobs the next day just to look and check.
facts.evidence: But I go back for checks on ongoing jobs. Just when I go back the next day, just to look.

facts.heading: Boss calls him careful

facts.evidence: The boss tells me I'm the most careful in the company,

facts.heading: Work slowing down recently

facts.evidence: In the last few months, the work has slowed down by an hour per day.

facts.heading: Fear of losing job
facts.content: Tomas is afraid of losing his job, especially now.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid I'll lose my job. Especially now.

facts.heading: Partner is pregnant in fourth month
facts.content: Tomas's partner, Barbora, is pregnant in the fourth month.
facts.evidence: Probora is pregnant in the fourth month.

facts.heading: Waited three years for child

facts.evidence: We waited for it for three years,

facts.heading: Intrusive thought about harm
facts.content: Tomas has a thought that it would harm his partner and the baby.
facts.evidence: That it would harm her and the baby.

facts.heading: Thought about cutting bread

facts.evidence: the thought comes when I'm cutting bread on the landing and then I'm afraid that it will go by itself.

facts.evidence: It's the worst when I haven't told anyone. Not even Barbora.

facts.evidence: I leave the room. Or I come back and check something to make it stop.

facts.heading: Checking helps calm him
facts.content: Tomas confirmed that checking helps him calm the thoughts.

facts.evidence: I sleep intermittently. I get up twice at night and check sporadically, even if there is nothing there.

facts.evidence: Walks twice. A week. Well, just about.

facts.evidence: To leave the woods in five minutes.
